Gestational age is calculated from the first day of the last menstrual period (LMP) to the current date. The standard method uses a 7-day week and 40-week pregnancy duration. The formula is:  
Gestational age = (Current date - LMP date) in days, then converted to weeks and days.

Step 2: Values from the note  
- Last menstrual period (LMP): 07/18/2010  
- Today's date: 02/09/2011  

Step 3: Convert dates to day-of-year and compute difference  
We will compute the number of days between 07/18/2010 and 02/09/2011.

First, calculate the number of days from 07/18/2010 to 12/31/2010:  
- July 18 to July 31: 14 days (including July 18? No — we start counting from July 19, so 13 days)  
Actually, better to use a systematic method:  
- Days remaining in July 2010: 31 - 18 = 13 days (July 19 to July 31)  
- August: 31 days  
- September: 30 days  
- October: 31 days  
- November: 30 days  
- December: 31 days  
Total from July 18 to Dec 31, 2010:  
13 (Jul) + 31 (Aug) + 30 (Sep) + 31 (Oct) + 30 (Nov) + 31 (Dec) = 166 days

Now, days from Jan 1, 2011 to Feb 9, 2011:  
- January: 31 days  
- February: 9 days  
Total: 31 + 9 = 40 days

Total days between LMP and today: 166 + 40 = 206 days

Step 4: Convert days to weeks and days  
206 ÷ 7 = 29 weeks and 3 days (since 29 × 7 = 203, 206 - 203 = 3)

So, gestational age is 29 weeks and 3 days.

ANSWER: (29 weeks, 3 days)
